evidence.summary: DeepSeek Harness 衍生终端客户端，提供交互、exec、会话恢复及平台包启动入口。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、apps/cli/package.json、apps/cli/src/bin.ts、scripts/dsh-npm-shim.js、package.json、apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts、packages/bundle/headless/src/index.ts、packages/bundle/headless/src/startup.ts、packages/interaction/permission-presets/src/index.ts、apps/cli/install/install.sh、apps/cli/install/README.md、apps/cli/src/doctor.ts；CLI解析启动模式，组合profile并挂载Agent/模型/工具依赖，exec配置新建或恢复的Agent、消费本次事件并输出文本/JSONL；分发shim解析平台可执行包。
limitations: inventory统计覆盖固定仓库，人工聚焦apps/cli启动、headless任务、permission-presets和平台分发；不把抽读范围当全仓审计，不归因所有继承代码。未构建、安装、运行doctor/测试/模型任务。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 开发者在项目目录通过终端反复提交读改代码任务；以工件和既有测试审查为合格结果，不以回合完成代替验收。[Q01](#research-q01)
CLI解析启动模式，组合profile并挂载Agent/模型/工具依赖，exec配置新建或恢复的Agent、消费本次事件并输出文本/JSONL；分发shim解析平台可执行包。
inventory统计覆盖固定仓库，人工聚焦apps/cli启动、headless任务、permission-presets和平台分发；不把抽读范围当全仓审计，不归因所有继承代码。未构建、安装、运行doctor/测试/模型任务。
根private monorepo与apps/cli官方包身份、fork shim分发身份分别记录；源码版本0.1.0-rc.15不自动证明npm平台包和GitHub制品匹配。

#### 启动与依赖

| 条件 | 是否必需 | 作用 | 缺失时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 平台发行包与shim运行环境 | 分发方式相关 | shim选择macOS/Linux arm64/x64或Windows x64包 | 不支持架构/缺包直接报错，不自动退到源码 |
| profile及workspace插件 | 必需 | 组合Agent、会话、模型和工具 | loader/所需服务缺失阻止正常任务链 |
| 模型配置及API凭据 | 模型任务必需 | 提供实际推理服务 | 外部服务可用性和费用需用户核实 |
| 持久化home | resume必需 | 列出并加载历史会话 | last无候选失败，兼容性未验收 |
| 权限与平台隔离适配 | 执行必需 | 设置sandbox/approval及写根 | preset缺失/锁定报错；底层强度待平台核查 |

源码构建根声明Node ^22.19.0或>=24.0.0与pnpm；它不等同已核实可执行制品依赖。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金/资源 | 人工投入 | 条件与未知 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 平台包/源码下载、本地存储；金额未知 | 核实来源、PATH、模型凭据、profile及home | 未测分钟数，不能据单文件宣称零配置 |
| 持续 | 模型API、网络与工具执行资源 | 代码审查、权限选择、插件/MCP维护 | 外部价格和可用性本轮未核实 |
| 失败恢复 | 重新下载/旧版存储及可能重复API开销 | 查部分安装、状态兼容与残留操作 | 非原子多文件替换，恢复未实测 |
| 退出 | 保留旧发行物及配置存储 | 恢复别名/PATH并检查工件 | 删除程序不能回滚文件或远端副作用 |

对已有官方环境，收益差异不明使迁移负担当前不值得默认承担。[Q04](#research-q04) [Q05](#research-q05)
已有官方宿主的开发者当前保留原环境并观察。先固定官方差异与发行制品，再用独立home/副本项目核对默认权限、exec、resume、中断和旧版恢复，所有代码另做既有验收；无独有优势或制品/权限不可解释就停止迁移。[Q05](#research-q05)

#### 效果

| 项目 | 源码支持 | 未验证 |
|---|---|---|
| 平台分发入口 | shim选择包并透传参数/stdio/信号 | npm制品对应及真实安装成功 |
| exec脚本输出 | 本次事件、schema缺失检查和退出条件 | 代码正确性、节时与任务质量 |
| 恢复会话 | 显式ID/按createdAt和cwd选择last | 旧宿主迁移、外部操作中断/回滚 |
| 权限选择 | sandbox和approval分别写入策略 | 所有平台/工具实际强制隔离 |
| 诊断 | boot-free入口与超时参数 | 实际连接和相比官方排障优势 |

没有执行目标或比较用户任务，不将功能链当收益实测。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
启动setup先配置再发布Agent、sandbox与approval分别写事实、本次seq限定输出是明确工程边界。shim直接child信号、安装器逐文件写和profile SIGTERM零退出限制了可推导保证；只审定向链，未全面审计全部继承包。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
以终端入口、profile组合、可脚本化exec和平台包启动组织一个Harness衍生客户端。相对自行搭建源码，平台解析和诊断入口提供可检查的分发/排障路径；相对官方宿主的独有贡献尚未充分归因。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q04](#research-q04)
采用关键不是功能数量，而是fork是否有足够独有收益抵偿整个宿主的制品、配置和权限迁移。resume不是外部操作回滚，exec退出只约束模型回合/结构输出；升级是逐文件替换，不能当原子回退。底层跨平台隔离与同版本制品均未验收。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
比较平台shim加boot-free doctor是否相对固定官方发行物降低到首个合格任务的摩擦；先查官方是否已提供等效路径，再同OS/任务测安装成功、人工排障、权限与恢复，不牺牲业务验收。若只是包装或恢复变差则否定净收益，未执行不作已有贡献。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README:17与apps/cli官方包身份显示继承关系，但无固定官方全差异，novelty、mechanism和simplification无法归因，均null而非用0填未知；平台shim可能为包装便利，不能代替上游核对。[Q04](#research-q04)scripts/dsh-npm-shim.js:15-64的按平台解析/失败提示/信号转发是可迁移到其他CLI发行物的具体模式，transferability取25%（5），高于零因接口与调用完整，未到50%因属于常见分发组合且未证明新方法或跨项目效果，不声称fork原创该模式。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)和[Q05](#research-q05)尚缺固定官方功能与用户流程对照，workflow、delivery和economics无法判断fork独有增量，均null；不能把完整Agent交付或预期节时算进分支。[Q04](#research-q04)shim:15-38相对从源码建立workspace，为支持OS/CPU的人提供直接包启动路线，reach取25%（5），高于零因实际降低这一安装技能门槛，未到50%因不证明相对官方独有，也没有扩大采用人群的真实数据。

recommendation.reason: 已有官方Harness环境的开发者应先固定此CLI分支的独有需求和发行制品，再决定是否在副本项目验证迁移。它有可追溯的exec、会话恢复及平台启动链，但这些能力相对官方的差异和整体迁移收益尚未厘清。若制品来源、权限或旧版恢复无法解释，就保留原宿主、配置与PATH，不以回合退出码替代代码验收。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README:1-18和bin:27-71指出开发者在项目目录重复读改代码，合格结果以代码/测试验收，取50%（15），高于25%偶发便利因交互/exec/恢复任务链明确；未到75%因没有支持此fork迁移必要性的重复摩擦实例，已有官方宿主构成主要反例。

advantage.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)shim:15-38及doctor:55-90相对源码搭建提供局部分发/诊断便利，取25%（6），高于零因实际平台解析和入口存在；未到50%因[Q01](#research-q01)缺固定官方差异，已有官方CLI可能同等满足，不把继承exec及模型能力当额外价值。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)headless:203-315、[Q03](#research-q03)permission-presets:560-602与[Q04](#research-q04)安装/启动链覆盖核心入口、状态和主要失败，取50%（13），高于25%片段声明因真实调用及反证完整；未到75%因从未执行固定制品、权限、恢复或任务，官方优势缺口仍使迁移建议停留观察。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)install.sh:147-185逐文件安装并改别名/PATH，[Q02](#research-q02)会话恢复需兼容，[Q03](#research-q03)底层隔离未审计，取25%（5），高于零因保留旧发行物及独立home有可行退出路线；未到50%因整体宿主迁移/部分升级恢复和制品对应仍依赖用户额外核实，收益差异未明，不据无额外产品收费称低成本。

publication.summaries.text: DeepSeek Harness 衍生终端客户端，提供交互、exec、会话恢复及平台包启动入口。

items.用户命令: 终端profile启动、exec任务输出、持久化会话恢复、MCP/插件管理和doctor入口。
items.界面: 终端及浏览器profile启动别名，由组合profile提供具体界面。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| profile启动 | 组合模型/Agent/工具客户端 | 依赖配置与加载，不是普通宿主插件 |
| exec与JSONL | 脚本提交任务并消费本次输出 | 完成回合不等于代码验收 |
| 结构结果要求 | 指定schema及最后消息文件 | 未捕获合格结果失败，业务含义另验 |
| resume | 继续持久化会话 | last按创建时间和cwd，非外部回滚 |
| 权限快捷设置 | 选择sandbox/approval组合 | full-auto与yolo不同，管理员可锁定 |
| 平台npm shim | 解析系统架构并启动制品 | 支持平台有限，制品未实际验收 |
| doctor入口 | 不启动profile的环境诊断 | 外部probe非业务任务验证 |

publication.advice.text: 已有官方宿主的开发者当前保留原环境并观察。先固定官方差异与发行制品，再用独立home/副本项目核对默认权限、exec、resume、中断和旧版恢复，所有代码另做既有验收；无独有优势或制品/权限不可解释就停止迁移。[Q05](#research-q05)

DeepSeek CLI is an open-source coding agent powered by DeepSeek that runs locally in your terminal.

\n\n​
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
\n\n

\n \n

\n\n

9 interface languages · 6 theme palettes · Agentic coding from plan to execution

\n\n

\n \n

\n\n---\n\n**Note:** This is DeepSeek Harness CLI. We keep iterating in sync with the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), and we look forward to your forks and stars.\n\n\n\n## Quickstart\n\n### Install\n\nmacOS or Linux:\n\n```sh\ncurl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/master/apps/cli/install/install.sh | sh\n```\n\n\n\nWindows:\n\n```powershell\npowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c \"irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/master/apps/cli/install/install.ps1 | iex\"\n```\n\nYou can also install DeepSeek CLI with the following package managers:\n\n```sh\n# Install using npm\nnpm install -g @peiyu_wang/deepseek-harness-cli\n```\n\n```sh\n# Install using Homebrew\nbrew install --cask peiyuwang54/dsh/deepseek-harness-cli\n```\n\nThen open a project directory and run `deepseek` to get started. The shorter `dsh` alias is also available:\n\n```sh\ndeepseek\n# or\ndsh\n```\n\nStart the Web UI with `deepseek web`:\n\n```sh\ndeepseek web\n```\n\nThe command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md).\n\nRun a non-interactive task for scripts and CI with `deepseek exec`:\n\n```sh\ndeepseek exec \"run the tests\"\ndeepseek exec --json \"review this repository\"\ndeepseek exec resume --last \"continue\"\n```\n\nOn first launch, paste your DeepSeek API key into the masked prompt. The key is stored by the shared credential provider and never added to chat history. Use `/credentials` to inspect its source, replace it, or remove the saved value.\n\nFor automation, set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` before launch (`$env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=\"your-key\"` in PowerShell). An inherited environment value is read-only inside the CLI.\n\n### Permission modes\n\n```sh\ndeepseek\ndeepseek --full-auto\ndeepseek --yolo\n```\n\nUse `/permissions` during a session, or pass `--sandbox` and `--ask-for-approval` for exact controls. `--yolo` disables both confinement and approval prompts, so use it only in an isolated environment. See the [CLI behavior reference](apps/cli/reference/README.md#terminal-front-door) and [permission presets](packages/interaction/permission-presets/README.md).\n\n### MCP servers\n\n```sh\ndeepseek mcp add filesystem -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .\ndeepseek mcp list\n```\n\nUse `/mcp` in a running session to inspect connected servers. For HTTP OAuth, run `deepseek mcp auth `. See [MCP server management](apps/cli/reference/README.md#mcp-server-management) and the [MCP client reference](packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md) for transports, credentials, reloads, and capability details.\n\nDiagnose an installation without starting a profile, or install shell completion for both command names:\n\n```sh\ndeepseek doctor\ndeepseek doctor --json\ndeepseek completion zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_deepseek\n```\n\n`doctor` also checks shipped profile overlays and presets, the optional Web frontend asset, installation channel, sandbox runner, truecolor, mouse input, clipboard support, and every enabled managed MCP connection. MCP probes start the configured server with a 5000 ms per-request timeout; `--mcp-timeout-ms` changes it. Optional server failures and host capability checks are warnings; a required MCP server failure, missing runtime asset, or unsupported Node version is blocking.\n\nInspect and validate a profile's installed plugin bundles without starting it:\n\n```sh\ndeepseek plugin --profile tui list\ndeepseek plugin --profile tui verify --json\ndeepseek plugin --profile tui source \ndeepseek plugin --profile tui disable \ndeepseek plugin --profile tui enable \ndeepseek plugin --profile tui install \ndeepseek plugin --profile tui update\n```\n\n`source` shows the package directory and declared repository. `enable` and `disable` change the active Cordis bundle list and take effect on the next launch; `install`, `update`, and `remove` use pnpm for dependency resolution.\n\n## What it includes\n\n- Code reading, editing, shell tools, web search, skills, MCP, and subagents.\n- Persistent sessions with resume, plan, goal, queued messages, and automatic context compaction.\n- A Codex-style terminal UI with six theme palettes and English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Arabic, French, Russian, Spanish, Japanese, and Korean.\n- Plugin-based profiles for terminal, headless automation, and the Web UI.\n\n\n\n## Run from source\n\n```sh\ngit clone https://github.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli.git\ncd deepseek-harness-cli\npnpm install --frozen-lockfile\npnpm run build\npnpm dsh\n```\n\nSource builds require Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24` and pnpm `11.7.0`.\n\n`pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding.\n\n## Docs\n\n- [CLI commands and profiles](apps/cli/reference/README.md)\n- [Terminal UI and slash commands](packages/ui/tui/README.md)\n- [Configuration reference](docs/config-catalog.md)\n- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)\n- [Development](docs/development.md)\n\nReport bugs in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/issues).\n\n## License\n\nThis project is licensed under MIT. The POSIX script needs `curl`, `tar`, and a sha256 tool (`shasum` on macOS, `sha256sum` on Linux). The Windows script runs on Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7 and uses the system `tar.exe`.\n\n## Install\n\n### macOS and Linux\n\n```sh\ncurl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/master/apps/cli/install/install.sh | sh\n```\n\nAfter it finishes, restart your shell (or run the printed `export PATH=…` line), then run `deepseek` or `dsh`.\n\nFor fish, the installer writes a dedicated file under `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/fish/conf.d` and prints a fish-compatible PATH command. For macOS Bash, it updates `.bashrc` and the first existing login profile (`.bash_profile`, `.bash_login`, or `.profile`), creating `.bash_profile` if none exists.\n\n### Windows\n\n```powershell\npowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c \"irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/master/apps/cli/install/install.ps1 | iex\"\n```\n\nAfter it finishes, open a new terminal, then run `deepseek` or `dsh`.\n\n## Options\n\nPOSIX flags are passed after `--`:\n\n```sh\n# Install to a custom directory instead of $HOME/.deepseek-harness-cli\ncurl -fsSL | sh -s -- --to /usr/local\n\n# Pin a specific release (default: newest deepseek-harness-cli-v* release)\ncurl -fsSL | sh -s -- --version 0.1.0-rc.5\n```\n\nThe PowerShell script accepts named parameters:\n\n```powershell\n# Install to a custom directory and pin a release\npowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\\install.ps1 -InstallDir C:\\Tools\\deepseek -Version 0.1.0-rc.11\n```\n\nBoth scripts accept `DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_CLI_VERSION`, `DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_CLI_INSTALL_DIR`, `DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_CLI_BASE_URL`, and `DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_CLI_RELEASES_URL` for automation, mirrors, and version pinning. The PowerShell installer also accepts `DownloadAttempts`, `DownloadTimeoutSeconds`, and `DownloadRetryDelaySeconds`, or the corresponding `DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_CLI_DOWNLOAD_*` environment variables. Defaults are three attempts, 300 seconds per request, and two seconds between attempts.\n\n## Download recovery\n\nThe PowerShell installer applies the timeout and retry policy to release discovery, the tarball, and its checksum sidecar. It deletes an incomplete temporary file before retrying and reports the failing URL after the final attempt. A failed download or checksum check does not replace an existing installation.\n\n## Integrity\n\nThe installer verifies the tarball against the `deepseek-harness-cli--.sha256` sidecar published with the same release and aborts on mismatch without touching an already-installed binary. This detects corruption; replacing both files can bypass it.\n\nThe release workflow signs GitHub build provenance for each tarball. To verify a downloaded tarball before installation, use GitHub CLI and require this repository's release workflow identity:\n\n```sh\ngh attestation verify deepseek-harness-cli-x64-linux.tar.gz \\\n --repo peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli \\\n --signer-workflow peiyuwang54/deepseek-harness-cli/.github/workflows/deepseek-harness-cli-release.yml\n```\n\nThis explicit verification requires an attestation produced by the release workflow; older releases without one fail verification. The installers and Homebrew cask automatically check checksums only. npm publications also request provenance; switching registry authentication to Trusted Publishing requires the package owner to configure the npm trusted publisher first.\n\n## Development\n\nTests are keyless and mock the release server over localhost:\n\n```sh\npython3 apps/cli/install/tests/test_install_sh.py\npnpm exec
